newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products - gas oil tracks expiry, HSFO up.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - gas oil tracks expiry, HSFO up.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Thursday with the June gas oil futures contract expiring.
Gas oil eased in line with futures but trade was minimal amid the expiry of the June IPE contract. Heating oil barges were offered at July IPE +50 cents fob ARA.
Gasoline cargoes were weaker on a shut arb to the States but barges were lifted by prompt buying. Naphtha was steady.
High sulphur fuel oil barges rose to trade $85 and $86 a tonne fob Rotterdam after an early trade at $83 which traders said did not reflect the market. Late offers were near $86.
High sulphur cargoes were quiet early.
A cargo of Russian E-4 traded on Wedneseday at three means plus $2.50 -- a price said to reflect current market values.
